artworks.title: Pygmalion and Galatea
artworks.description: Gérôme's marble maiden warming into flesh under the sculptor's kiss — Ovid's festival miracle as academic theatre.

films.title: My Fair Lady
films.description: Cukor's musical film of Lerner and Loewe — Eliza and Higgins as the modern Pygmalion myth of speech, class, and creation.

music.title: My Fair Lady
music.description: Lerner and Loewe's Broadway musical after Shaw — the sculptor's myth remade as phonetics and a flower girl's transformation.

popCulture.title: Pygmalion (play)
popCulture.creator: George Bernard Shaw
popCulture.description: Shaw's comedy of manners named for the Cypriot sculptor — language as the chisel that shapes a living Galatea.

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Book 10 — the ivory bride Venus warms to life: the source text every later Pygmalion still answers.

popCulture.title: Pygmalion
popCulture.description: The sculptor who loved his own art into flesh — still the name for creators who fall for what they make.
